criteria.text: Parse controlled Anthropic request JSON into a normalized scoring prompt and extract the exact BODY section.
criteria.reason: Controlled Anthropic JSON proves metadata decoys are ignored and only the exact BODY section is returned.

criteria.text: Classify candidate only by exact purpose plus UUID candidate body, accept one or more repeated exact generated-draft score requests as legitimate, require their distinct-body set to equal only the expected draft body, and require the known overlap candidate as the sole other score request; still require exactly one candidate request and one UUID pinned/hash proposal.
criteria.reason: The live harness now requires the exact candidate body, one-or-more exact draft requests with the distinct-body set limited to expectedDraftBody, the exact overlap fixture body as the sole other score request, and one UUID pinned/hash proposal.

criteria.text: Exclude synthetic seed-session local IDs from engine cleanup; for each distinct real cwd make at most two five-second status attempts, treat busy/retry abort or idle-proof failures as fatal, and never delete an engine session without idle proof.
criteria.reason: Engine cleanup excludes ids-owned synthetic seed rows, retries status at most twice per real cwd with five-second request bounds, keeps abort/idle failures fatal, and gates deletion on idle proof.

criteria.text: Fixture closure, provider restoration, database settlement, zero residual rows, strict final baseline/integrity, and provider baseline remain fatal; status unavailability is diagnostic only after bounded retry when fixture/provider are closed, residual rows are zero, strict proofs pass, and broad rows remain stable for two continuous seconds before cleanup decisions and after deletion.
criteria.reason: The settle helper resets stableSince on every digest change; teardown requires two continuous stable seconds before cleanup and after deletion, and permits status-unavailable diagnostics only after all fatal fixture/provider/residual/baseline/integrity proofs pass.
